rules.V-FIELD-01: A field value fails the shared format check (ID shape, code shape, range, date sanity).
rules.V-CROSS-01: Two fields contradict each other (approved above requested, end date before start date).
rules.C-NPR-01: No payer plus member/auth identifier and no decision wording: not a payer response.
rules.C-NPR-02: No decision wording and no unit counts: not a payer response.
rules.C-NPR-03: Payer-like letter with no usable decision evidence: not a payer response.
rules.C-DEN-02: Decision wording says denied and no approved units are stated: full denial.
rules.C-PART-01: Approved units are fewer than requested units: partial denial.
rules.C-PART-02: Approved dates cover less than the requested dates: partial denial.
rules.C-APP-01: Units and dates approved as requested: authorization approved.
rules.C-APP-02: Decision wording says approved with no unit counts: authorization approved.
rules.C-CONFLICT-01: The model's label disagrees with what the numbers say: human review.
rules.C-CONFLICT-02: The printed decision wording disagrees with the numbers: human review.
rules.R-MISSING_DOCUMENTATION: Reason text matches the missing documentation keywords.
rules.R-MEDICAL_NECESSITY: Reason text matches the medical necessity keywords.
rules.R-ELIGIBILITY: Reason text matches the eligibility keywords.
rules.R-EXPIRED_AUTH: Reason text matches the expired authorization keywords.
rules.R-CODING: Reason text matches the coding keywords.
rules.R-MULTI-01: Reason text matches more than one category: a person decides.
rules.R-NONE-01: A denial with no stated reason: human review.
rules.R-NONE-02: Reason text matches no category: human review.
rules.G-MISSING-01: A field required for this document type is missing.
rules.G-CONF-01: A required field is below the 0.80 confidence floor.
rules.G-DISAGREE-01: Two independent model readers disagree on a high-stakes field.
rules.Q-APP-01: Approvals are filed with no denial action.
rules.Q-NPR-01: Documents that are not payer responses are filed with no action.
rules.Q-MISSING_DOCUMENTATION: Route to the missing documentation queue.
rules.Q-MEDICAL_NECESSITY: Route to the medical necessity queue.
rules.Q-EXPIRED_AUTH: Route to the expired authorization queue.
rules.Q-REVIEW-01: Any failed check routes the document to human review with reasons attached.
rules.P-DEADLINE-01: Appeal window of 30 days or fewer from the letter date: high priority.

payer_name.description: Name of the insurance plan or payer that sent the letter.

member_id.description: Member or subscriber ID as printed on the letter.

auth_number.description: Authorization number, or the payer's reference number if no authorization number is printed.

service_code.description: Service code (CPT or HCPCS), for example 97153.

approved_units.description: Units the payer approved. Use 0 when nothing was approved.

requested_start.description: Start of the requested service period.

requested_end.description: End of the requested service period.

approved_start.description: Start of the approved service period.

approved_end.description: End of the approved service period.

decision_text.description: The decision wording exactly as printed, for example 'Approved' or 'Denied' or 'Approved in part'.

denial_reason_text.description: The payer's stated reason for the denial, copied as printed. Null if none.

appeal_deadline.description: Last day to appeal, if the letter states one.
